title: NAZARRHS
text:
NAZARRHS, eN NAZARA or Mazareta, a term which again like one who is of Nazareth, or any native of the city of Nazareth. It was given to Jesus Christ or the disciples, also is commonly accepted in a sense of derision and economy by close authors who have written against Christianity. It has also been applied to a set of herself called Germers, and sometimes it meant Nazareth, or one who has laid himself under the obligation of a vow to observe the rules of Nazareth, physically whether the for his whole life, as theses and John the Baptist, or only for a time, as in the case of those mentioned in November (vi. th. 19, 200) and Anna Kis (1), 12). Lastly, the same for example, some passages of Sculpture, denotes a man of particular distinction and great viginity in the court of some privacy. Of these several sorts of Nazareths we shall now give some account.

The name of Nazarene belongs to Jesus Christ, not only because of his having lived the greater part of his life at Nazareth, and became this city has always been smaller, and as his country, but also because the prophets had foretold that he should be called to Nazarem (Mattie i; 28). “ And he came and done in a city called Nazareth, that might be frilibled which was spoken by the prophets. He shall be called to Nazarem.” We find in particular passage in the prophets where it is as that the Messiah should be called a Nazarene; and St Matthew only quotes
